summary: Chapter 2 dramatizes Feuz's discovery of the reused formula and Stettler's near-confession to Rutz, but along the way it renames the victim, gives Melchior's death a false autopsy and poisoning, swaps Stettler's office, replaces the shared certificate formula with a chemical one, and stages Berta as domestic help in another man's household.

issues.fix_hint: restore the name canon gives her: Klara Vogel, with no first name change and no invented maiden name

issues.unit: die Zusammensetzung des Präparats, das man im Magen gefunden hatte
issues.fix_hint: cut the autopsy/poison finding; canon records Melchior's file as a fall with no autopsy performed, and Klara's cover was a forged heart-failure certificate, not a stomach finding
use the office canon gives him, Amtsarzt (district physician), not Amtsstatthalter, and remove the other two instances of the title in this chapter

issues.unit: auch hier die Formel, Wort für Wort dieselbe
issues.fix_hint: the shared, identical formula canon gives is the certificate wording 'Herzversagen, vermutlich beim Sturz', not a chemical preparation composition

issues.unit: Zu Hause hatte Berta die Suppe schon aufgetragen
issues.fix_hint: keep Berta in her own household as Melchior's widow; do not place her serving food at the stove in another character's home
